newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 27.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 4.53 points at 6,880.70, helped by a quick recovery by battered technology stocks, but bank stocks fell a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time in more than two years.

* Indonesian Tourism, Post and Telecommunications Minister Joop Ave was quoted by newspapers on Thursday as saying the government had no intention of abolishing Telkom's monopoly over basic telecommunications services ahead of schedule.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta Composite Index ended 2.07 points higher at 659.39 points after a slight adjustment after the close.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,402.00/02.25 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,401.50/02.50.
* Telkom on news reports that the government had no intention of abolishing Telkom's telecommunications monopoly.
* Modernland on market talk of a possible link-up with one Japanese property firm. The firm had denied the rumour.
* Duta Pertiwi after its shareholders on Tuesday approved the firm's proposed rights issue.

* Cigarette firms Sampoerna and Gudang Garam on reports of a new government regulation prohibiting a link-up between two or more cigarette firms be it in the form of capital, production, marketing or management.
